purpose: Finite descriptive real command-tracking panel and future fixed input-perturbation stability; not latent truth accuracy.
source: KIT Zenodo17866847 v1.0.0 LF, original source order and microsecond timestamp decoding

selection.order: Within recording/direction ascending original edge_index, edge_time_us, event_id as tie
selection.uniform_index: For n>=4, floor(j*(n-1)/3), j=0,1,2,3; n<4 retain all, no replacement.

aggregation.method: Arithmetic mean of original observations with start<=relative_time_us<end, not a continuous-time integral.

units.native_time: integer microseconds; source elapsed differences, not physical instrument microsecond accuracy
units.progress: dimensionless command-step normalized observed current change

future_methods: Raw description and isolated seconds adapters for TFstandard/CPOP/LABS; this script runs none.
